profile.description: Balanced low-TTFA profile for concurrent streaming requests on an 8-core Intel AMX host with SMT disabled.

hardware.notes: Disable SMT before launch. The qualified workers use CPUs 0-3 and 4-7, one thread per physical core. The host has one NUMA node and a 260 MiB shared L3.

requirements.isa: AVX-512 VNNI, AVX-512 BF16, AMX tile, AMX INT8 and AMX BF16

server.worker_affinity: worker 0 -> CPUs 0-3; worker 1 -> CPUs 4-7, after SMT is disabled

precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; int8 packing is internal to matmat
precision.gemm_backend: AMX INT8/BF16 GEMM where the shape gate is met; shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI and AVX-512 BF16 fallbacks otherwise

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Must be absent so the engine sizes OpenBLAS from each worker's phase thread budget.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: set it explicitly only for a measured override

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Prevents idle OpenBLAS workers from spinning against the engine pool.

QWEN_AMX_MIN_B.why: Enables AMX INT8 matmat from the first batched regime.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Enables reuse of request-independent prefix work.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware AVX-512 VNNI fallback remains available.
QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.revert: set QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE=1 only for a control run

qualification.workload: Three synchronized waves at client concurrency 2, 4, 6 and 8 on the mixed 21-text qualification bank; SMT was disabled and each worker was pinned to a physical-core slice.
qualification.notes: Latest SMT-off measurements gave TTFA p50/p95: C=2 176/421 ms, C=4 549/684 ms, C=6 655/1093 ms, C=8 890/1327 ms. This topology was the balanced concurrent choice: it gave the best measured request throughput at C=4, C=6 and C=8 among the tested topologies, while C=2 is the strict low-TTFA operating point.
